images.description: Referral page in the Pocket layout for a preview-cohort owner: scannable QR of the referral link, two-line title, milestone timeline card, pinned full-width Share pill (OmiButton) and close control. iPhone 17 Pro simulator, light mode, default text, local backend with the preview cohort set.
Same page after closing and reopening it from Settings a third time; the same link and layout load each time.
Dark mode: the QR card keeps its white background and black modules, the milestone card sits on the dark surface, and Share is the white accent pill with a black label.
Largest accessibility text size: the title wraps word by word without clipping, the page scrolls under the pinned Share pill, and the Share label grows inside the button without clipping.
Tapping the QR copies the link; the Copied toast floats above the pinned Share pill instead of covering it.
Share tapped immediately after a copy, while the Copied toast was still showing: the native share sheet opens with the full referral link.

iPhone 17 Pro simulator. State A: two friends attributed, checked out and paid (settle_order), nothing claimed, so 2 claimable months. Claim pill on the first reward row, beside its copy, with a filled check; light mode, default text. Local backend in preview mode reading the real Firestore-emulator ledger for preview owner mux-referral-owner, seeded through the backend's own ledger functions; final source 58d64127b7.
